{{Top|leg}}
A '''direct democracy''' was a system of [[:Category:Governments|government]], a type of [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]]. In a direct democracy, the people chose representatives who would assemble (for instance, in a world [[Senate]]) and vote about global matters. It was considered an optimist government, as it valued the opinion of each of its components.<ref name="Essential Guide">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]] had a direct democracy. The [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthes]] formed a Senate with electees selected by local governments. Commonly female H'nemthes had the higher elected positions, because male H'nemthes were prone to [[Death/Legends|die]] suddenly. Young female H'nemthes commonly studied [[Politics|political]] sciences and history to prepare for their roles as representatives of their society.<ref name="Essential Guide" />
